title: Covered-Systems Bonus on the Replacement System Installations Member Install Credit
content:
# Covered-systems bonus

The covered-systems bonus of the member install credit on a Replacement System Installations contract follows the number of systems covered by the homeowner's Comfort Club agreement, as shown on the agreement in the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements records:

| Systems covered by the agreement | Covered-systems bonus |
|---|---|
| Three or more | $100.00 |
| Exactly two | $50.00 |
| A single system | None |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical agreements)

- An agreement covering four systems: $100.00 — four is three or more.
- An agreement covering exactly three systems: $100.00.
- An agreement covering two systems: $50.00.
- An agreement covering one system: no covered-systems bonus.

The count is the agreement's own number of covered systems, not the number of installation projects the homeowner holds.
